name: My Zypp Stikks 28 Pack x 1g Prerolls - Apple Fritter
description:
Twenty-eight joints, one jar. The My Zypp Stikks Apple Fritter 28-pack gives you twenty-eight full-gram pre-rolls — 28 grams total — rolled and ready to smoke, packed in a sealed jar that keeps them fresh. No grinding, no rolling, no running out.

Apple Fritter serves up that fresh-out-the-oven flavor: sweet baked apple and warm cinnamon-sugar notes up front with a smooth, glazed-pastry finish.

28 × 1G pre-rolls — 28 grams total, serious value in one jar
Jar packaging — keeps every joint fresh and protected
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Apple Fritter flavor — sweet baked apple and cinnamon sugar with a glazed finish

My Zypp Stikks Apple Fritter is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
